title: Waiting Buys Exactly Two Moments: Endogenous Identification in Prediction-Driven Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2610.23830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A planner with a fixed budget of preventive help must decide whom to help and when. Waiting reveals risk but removes intervention opportunities as higher-risk individuals leave first. We characterize this tradeoff under repeated noisy signals and risk-dependent attrition: in the canonical model, a length-$\tau$ observation prefix identifies exactly the latent risk moments $m_j=\mathbb E[p^j]$ for $j=0,\ldots,2\tau-1$, buying two new moments per additional period. These identify average next-period attrition among survivors but need not identify allocation welfare or attrition among those prioritized for treatment. Our observationally equivalent constructions establish unavoidable timing regret at any sample size for a fixed observation length, while exact certificates determine whether all compatible populations share a unique optimal date. Matched experiments separate the effects of estimation, bootstrap averaging, and regret weighting.

translated_title: 等待恰好买到两个矩：预测驱动分配中的内生识别
translated_abstract: 拥有固定预防性援助预算的规划者必须决定帮助谁以及何时帮助。等待能够揭示风险，但随着高风险个体率先离开，等待也会消除干预的机会。我们在重复噪声信号和风险依赖流失的设定下刻画了这一权衡：在规范模型中，长度为 $\tau$ 的观测前缀恰好能识别潜在风险矩 $m_j=\mathbb E[p^j]$（$j=0,\ldots,2\tau-1$），即每多观察一个周期就能“买到”两个新的矩。这些矩可以识别幸存者中下一周期的平均流失率，但未必能识别分配福利或被优先治疗群体的流失率。我们通过观测等价的构造证明：在固定观测长度下，无论样本量多大，时机上的遗憾都不可避免；而精确证书则可判定所有相容总体是否共享唯一的最优干预日期。匹配实验分离了估计、自助法平均和遗憾加权各自的影响。
tldr: 该论文证明了在预测驱动的资源分配中，等待观测τ个周期能恰好识别2τ个潜在风险矩（每多等一期新增两个矩），但这种内生识别无法避免时机遗憾，且未必能判定唯一的最优干预日期。
en_tdlr: In prediction-driven allocation, a τ-period waiting prefix exactly identifies 2τ latent risk moments (buying two new moments per additional period), yet timing regret remains unavoidable at any sample size and a unique optimal intervention date is not always identifiable.
